denmark.line: The deal was made in Denmark
stanza: From the Land of the Midnight Sun
With a Thompson gun for hire
The deal was made in Denmark
On a dark and stormy day
So he set out for Biafra
One dream, one life, one lover

skylark.line: This song was originally published in 1941. Johnny Mercer took more than a year…
stanza: This song was originally published in 1941. Johnny Mercer took more than a year…
Have you anything to say to me?
Won't you tell me where my love can be?
Is there a meadow in the mist
Where someone's waiting to be kissed?
